note: DecisionLinks.link's rule (Phase 3, thread memory): for each decision D, in meetingAt order, candidates are decisions E with E.meetingAt < D.meetingAt (a strictly earlier MEETING; a same-meeting candidate has the same meetingAt and is excluded by the strict '<' alone) and both vectors present. E qualifies when cosine(D,E) >= LINK_COSINE (0.72), or cosine >= LINK_COSINE_WITH_WORD (0.60) and sharedContentWord(D.text, E.text). The best qualifying cosine wins; at most one link per D. Cosines here are INJECTED (DecisionLinksTest passes a lookup in place of a real vector dot product) so the golden can pin the threshold arithmetic directly; sharedContentWord still runs over the real 'text' fields. 'cos' is an NxN matrix over 'decisions' in array order; cos[i][j] is the score DecisionLinks would compute between decisions[i] (as D) and decisions[j] (as a candidate E). 'links' gives only the itemIds that DO get a link, each mapped to the earlier itemId it links to; every other itemId must be absent from DecisionLinks.link's result. Read by DecisionLinksTest.kt.
